scope: Every released Phase-A registered (runtime identity, scene/reset, static instruction, requested-relation) condition whose runtime exposes a real effective stochastic policy-sampling seed.
rollout_contract: For each eligible registered condition, execute exactly one rollout at each of the sixteen shared policy-sampling-seed indices while holding scene/reset, prompt bytes, checkpoint/runtime identity, controller, scorer, and artifact contract fixed.
eligibility_gate: The runtime must document an exposed policy sampling-seed input and pass a fixed-observation effective-seed check showing that at least two registered seed indices produce distinguishable raw policy samples. A deterministic runtime or one with no effective seed is ineligible and is reported as such; it receives no fake repeated rollouts.
analysis_unit: Policy-sampling rollout nested within its registered condition, then condition nested within scene/pair and model. The sixteen rollouts are not sixteen independent scenes or independent scene-level samples.
accounting: For each eligible released Phase-A condition, 16 additional rollouts are registered. Total Phase-D episodes are conditional on the set of released, seed-effective conditions and are reported by arena/model/scene/pair without pooling.
